scoring: temporal = 1 - |lag_days|/30; entity = 1.0 same entity, 0.6 named counterparty; commodity = 1.0 match else 0; volatility weight = 1.0 low, 0.9 medium, 0.8 high; score = mean(temporal, entity, commodity) x volatility weight. Computed in the browser from these inputs, not hand-set.
